system.description: Cluster Gallery. The detonation creates 4 mini charges which each land on a point of your choice within 20-feet of the triggering explosions affected area. Each mini charge then explodes in a 5-foot radius forcing creatures in each new zone to make their saving throw, gaining 1 rank of Concussed and being knocked Prone on a failed save. A creature can be affected by up to 2 mini charge at a time, but only make a saving throw once to determine if you suffer the mini charges effect twice.
